title: fix(plugin-webhooks, cli): a departed package's activation row switches no remaining webhook holder, and the ownership ceremony never picks a holder for a two-holder copy (ADR-0150 D8)
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDZYUbJbnXUTqZoZ56k4czR)_
Fixes #32695

Clause-②: yes (widening; narrowing on a departed row switched on) — widening: a departed package's row switched off no longer keeps a remaining holder off, so its outbound deliveries start on upgrade. Narrowing: a departed package's row switched on no longer turns on a holder shipped inactive.
Metadata-protocol: none

Area-lease pilot #33059 · area E2 · seat `domain:server#5` · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyrFFk86Jqf7Mp5Rzw

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：(S1) webhook 的启停开关里，一条点名“已不再声明该名字的包”的激活行，不再被当作剩下持有者的开关；(S4) 18.x 归属仪式里，两个包同名声明时，未写包的定制副本不再随便挑“列表最后一个包”，改写成不点名包的行并在报告里点名两个持有者。
- 为什么改：卸载包留下的旧开关会把另一个包的 webhook 打开或关掉（真实对外推送），属于 ADR-0150 D8 禁止的“替别人做决定”；仪式里按列表顺序挑包也是猜。
- 风险与回滚：只改 plugin-webhooks 的一个判定函数和 CLI 仪式一步；不点名包的行、持有者自己的行读法不变。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-webhooks/src/declared-webhooks.ts` 的 `webhookSlotSwitch` 与 `reportUnownedRows`；`packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.ts` 的 declared-webhooks 步骤。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-webhooks exec vitest run src/declared-webhooks.test.ts`，预期 59 个全过（含 `[#32695]` 四条）。
- 需要你做的：无，区域线程在复审通过后落地。

## What changes

**S1 — a departed package's activation row (`plugin-webhooks`).** `webhookSlotSwitch` read, for a slot with no row of its own, every row that is no slot's own: rows naming no package AND rows naming a package that no longer declares the name. Under one holder those were its switch (`if (slots.length <= 1) return unowned.every(Boolean)`), so a departed package's row switched the remaining holder in both directions; under two, an off row kept both off. Now only a row naming no package (while the environment declares nothing of the name) is read that way — the D8 row a name-keyed reader wrote before. A departed package's row switches no slot, at any holder count, and `DeclaredWebhookSource` says so once per name at `warn` (new export `departedWebhookRows`), naming the departed package, the holders and the per-holder address `?package=PACKAGE` (PR #33204).

**S4 — the 18.x ownership ceremony (`cli`).** The declared-webhooks step built `new Map(list.map(d => [d.name, d.packageId]))`, so under two holders of a name the holder listed LAST was the fallback for a customized copy whose definition names no package. Now the step keeps every holder per name; such a copy's activation row names the name's one holder, or — under two or more — no package (the name-keyed switch it was: off keeps each holder with no row of its own off, on turns none on), and the step's notes name every holder and the per-holder address. The card offered "refuse or report"; reporting keeps the run from blocking on a copy whose switch has a non-guessing spelling, and nothing is picked.

FROM → TO:

| Case | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|
| one holder, departed row off, holder shipped on | holder off | holder on (declared default) |
| one holder shipped off, departed row on | holder on | holder off (declared default) |
| two holders, departed row off | both off | each at its own row / declared default |
| ceremony: two package holders, customized copy naming no package | activation row names the last-listed holder | row names no package; note names both |
| ceremony: the environment and a package hold the name, customized copy naming no package (either order) | row names the last-listed holder | no switch row written; note reports the copy's switch and names both (review S1) |
| row naming no package; a holder's own row; one-holder ceremony | unchanged | unchanged |

**On `Clause-②`:** re-declared `yes (widening; narrowing on a departed row switched on)` per review S2, the spelling review#3 accepted on #33252: the departed-off rows start outbound deliveries on upgrade with no operator action (widening), the departed-on row stops one (narrowing). The changeset carries the operator line: to keep such a webhook off, switch the holder off at `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/webhook/NAME?package=PACKAGE`; the `warn` names that address. No export in the published index moves (`departedWebhookRows` is module-internal).

**Review round 1 (head 399e5501, review#3 FAIL) → 9eefd98b:** S1: when the environment is one of a name's holders, the ceremony no longer writes a package-less row for a copy naming no package (that row is the environment slot's own switch, so it picked the environment); it writes none and reports the copy's switch naming every holder. A clone of such a copy is not switched either and says so. S2: Clause-② re-declared, operator line added. N1: `reportUnownedRows` no longer returns after the departed-row warning, so a name with both a departed row and a package-less row under two holders is told both, each once.

## Tests

- `plugin-webhooks/src/declared-webhooks.test.ts`: the `[D8] one holder` pin no longer pins the departed row as the switch (that is the defect); new describe `[#32695] a departed package's row switches no remaining holder`: one holder both directions; two holders in both registration orders; said once naming departed package, holders and the address; CONTROL package-less row and own row; two holders with a departed row and a package-less row — each warning said once (N1).
- `cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-apply.generation-1.test.ts` (integration project): two holders with the second listed last and first — the row names no package, one note naming both; the environment and a package, the environment listed last and first — no switch row, one note naming both, and not the name-keyed note; CONTROL a copy naming its package beside a second holder listed first; CONTROL one holder, copy naming no package.

## Acceptance notes

- `setActivation` (cli) reads and updates an existing activation row by `(metadata_type, name)` only, whatever its `package_id`. Pre-existing and unchanged here; on an 18.x database the ceremony runs before any per-package row exists. Noted, not filed (no repro on a real upgrade path).
- The pristine-copy re-source still writes `declared:NAME` (no package) for deliveries; a two-holder redelivery of such a row is refused naming both (`[Q4]` pin, unchanged).
